notes.title: Update #5 - Patience Update
notes.content:
It's been 2 and a half years since Social Justice Warriors was released and unfortunately the game is more relevant than ever. Online discourse has only become more combative as the divisions between ideological groups have widened further.

In response, I've released a remastered edition of Social Justice Warriors that adds clickable buttons and mouse support, improves text scaling to support higher resolutions, and renames the Patience health meter to better represent the intended meaning. This free update also fixes a number of gameplay bugs and adds an in-game Options menu, a postgame recap, and online leaderboards.

I hope that playing Social Justice Warriors gives you a lot to think about.
Good luck out there!

[I found and patched a few more bugs in the 24 hours after release, including one major one, so I reset the leaderboards to compensate. Sorry!]

notes.title: Achievement Unlocked!
notes.content:
Good news, warriors and trolls! Achievements are now fully functional. Thanks for allowing a few days to get everything up and running.

[img]http://www.nonadecimal.com/staging/SJW/winsomeidol.png[/img]

This is my first Steam release so there was a lot to learn very quickly to release the game in the few weeks between PAX South and PAX East.  Remember, if you encounter any bugs or technical problems, you can report them in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348270/discussions/1/617329150701826260]Technical Support discussion thread[/url] with steps to reproduce and the OS you're using and receive notification when it's been resolved.

Meanwhile, I will be fixing some small issues and adding new content to expand the current warrior and troll repertoire of:[b]
[list]
[*] 30 player attacks with more than 500 lines of dialog
[*] more than 8 trolls wielding over 300 specialized attacks, totalling more than 1100 lines of dialog
[/list]
That's more variety than most real life arguments! [/b]

Now get out there and earn some achievements!

[img]http://www.nonadecimal.com/staging/SJW/achievementlocked.png[/img]
